spans.s:
अर्च् {c1c} U. (अर्चति-ते, आनर्च,
आर्चीत्, अर्चितुं, अर्चित)
1 (a) To adore
worship, salute, welcome with
respect;

honours, respectfully obeys. (b) To
honour, i. e. decorate, adorn;

.
--2 To praise (Ved.).
--3 To shine.
--{c10c} P. or

.
--2 To praise.
--3 To cause to
shine. --Desid. [अर्चिचिषति] To wish
to worship --WITH अनु to
congratulate, hail with joy.
--प्र {1} to praise,
sing praises of. {2} to honour,
worship; प्रानर्चुरर्च्या जगदर्चनीयं

; (--caus.) to honour.
--सं {1}
to worship, adore. {2} to fix, settle,
establish.

अर्चा [अर्च्-अङ्]
1 Worship,
adoration.
--2 An idol or image
intended to be worshipped;
मौर्यैर्हिरण्यार्थिभिरर्चाः प्रकल्पिताः Mbh. (there is some
dispute among scholars as to the
precise meaning of this passage).

]
1 Devout,
worshipping, pious.
--2 Relating to,
the Ṛk or Ṛgveda.

अर्चक a. [अर्च्-ण्वुल्] Worshipping,
adoring.
--कः A worshipper;
गुरुदेवद्विजार्चकः

अर्चत्र्य a. Ved. To be praised or
worshipped.

अर्चन a. [अर्च्-ल्युट्] Worshipping,
praising.
--नं, --ना Worship,
reverence or respect paid to deities and
superiors.

अर्चनीय, अर्च्य pot. p.
[अर्च्-अनीयर् ण्यत्] To be adored or
worshipped, venerable, adorable,
respectable

अर्चनीय, अर्च्य pot. p.
[अर्च्-अनीयर् ण्यत्] To be adored or
worshipped, venerable, adorable,
respectable

अर्चित p. p. Worshipped,
respected, honoured;

अर्चिन् a.
1 Praising,
honouring, worshipping.
--2 Shining as
a ray of light, radiating. --m.
(र्ची) A ray of light.

(said to be also.
f.) --f. N. of the wife of कृशाश्व and
mother of धूमकेतु. --m.
1 A ray of
light.
--2 Fire.

अर्चिष्मत् a. [अस्त्यर्थे मतुप्] Flaming,
brilliant, bright;

. --m.
1 Fire,
the god of fire.
--2 The sun.
--3 A
sort of subordinate deity.
--4 N. of
Viṣṇu.
--ती
1 N. of the town or
world of Agni.
--2 One of the 10
earths according to Buddhists.

आर्चिक a. (की f.) [ऋचि भवः.
ऋचो व्याख्यानो ग्रंथो वा ठञ्] Relating to
the Ṛgveda, or explaining it.
--कं
An epithet of the Sāma-Veda.

आर्चीक a. [ऋचीके पर्वते भवः अण्]
Belonging to the ऋचीक mountain.
--कः The mountain ऋचीक.
